faq.q: What is the origin of Ertan?
faq.a: Ertan is associated with Turkish. Ertan is Turkish, from er ('man') + tan ('dawn'), meaning 'man of dawn'.
No — the underlying form is Turkish, not Arabic.
Ertan can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Turkish-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
